WITH group_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        s.zoneref AS site_code,
        st.healtheval AS health_status,
        AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_size_per_minute,
        COUNT(*) AS scan_count
    FROM scans AS s
    JOIN sites AS st ON st.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
    WHERE s.chronotag::text > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274'
      AND s.chronotag::text < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
    GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.healtheval
),
with_mean AS (
    SELECT
        gm.*,
        AVG(avg_size_per_minute) OVER () AS mean_group_average
    FROM group_metrics AS gm
)
SELECT
    site_code,
    health_status,
    avg_size_per_minute,
    scan_count,
    avg_size_per_minute - mean_group_average AS amount_above_mean
FROM with_mean
WHERE mean_group_average IS NOT NULL
  AND avg_size_per_minute > mean_group_average
ORDER BY amount_above_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A scan with a zero duration is excluded from the per-scan ratio because division by zero is undefined; AVG then ignores that NULL ratio, while the scan remains included in the scan count.
